# Vendored dependencies

These repositories are vendored as source snapshots. Their internal `.git`
directories are intentionally omitted so the files are tracked directly by
Veridis-tille.

- `basic-pitch`: <https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch>, commit
  `fa5997af0a8210982619003269994a1be25eddf3`
- `spleeter`: <https://github.com/deezer/spleeter>, commit
  `c8854001ac8acad34a9bc2bd15f28475541828b1`

Each project remains covered by the license included in its own directory.
